Ethan: Heads-up — longctx stress runs show VRAM steadily growing on H100 with PagedAttention. After ~10k tokens we start seeing repeated page evictions and re-allocs, overall vram climbs ~1.2GB per 5k tokens.
Maya: repro steps? which model/config?
Ethan: small repro: 32-beam chat simulation, tiled kernels + kv paging enabled. Run on h100x4, seq=32 -> 16k tokens. Attaching trace snippet below.
Ethan: ```
[kv_pager] evict page_idx=0x3f2a owner=0x12 ts=162345 v=1
[kv_pager] alloc page_idx=0x3f2a owner=0x12 ts=162330 v=2
[kv_pager] evict page_idx=0x3f2a owner=0x12 ts=162321 v=1
```
Ethan: note non-monotonic v values and evict/alloc interleaving for same page id.
Rohit: interesting — on MI250 runs we see fewer repeats. Do we pick the same kernel on both? kernel selection could change allocation cadence.
Maya: I compared kernel selection: H100 uses tiled_attn_v2, MI250 picks strided_attn_opt for same config (fallback path). Could be ordering diff.
Anna: non-monotonic reuse counters smell like a race in the page-table coalesce path — probably stale owner tag being re-used before release. Any sign of missing barriers?
Ethan: perf counters show many concurrent evict completions overlapping with new allocs. nvprof slice:
Ethan: ```
GPU0: evict_complete_kernel (4.2ms) overlaps alloc_prepare (3.8ms) on stream 2
GPU0: page_fault_reclaim (1.1ms) queued behind alloc_prepare
```
Maya: repro command I used: `./run_longctx.sh --model small --batch 32 --seq 16384 --kv_paging=on --reuse_window=128`
Maya: config snippet:``` 
{"kv_paging":true, "prefetch":true, "pt_coalesce":true, "reuse_window":128}```
nv-pager-bot: evict_event: detected repeated-alloc pattern for page_idx=0x3f2a, count=8, threshold=5
Rohit: try flipping `pt_coalesce=false` and `prefetch=false` — if coalesce logic collapses async completion ordering, that could surface. Also test forcing same kernel selection across archs to rule out kernel-specific ordering.
Anna: agree. If disabling coalesce reduces churn, we likely have a missing serialization in the coalesce->free path.
Maya: I'll run quick matrix on H100/MI250: coalesce on/off, prefetch on/off, force_kernel=tiled|strided.
Ethan: FYI I bisected to a window: regression appears after the page-table change commit from two weeks ago (commit 1a2b3c). Suspect: coalesce rewrite.
Rohit: can you paste the commit link? I'll review atomic sequences.
Ethan: https://repo/commit/1a2b3c — main change was deferred_free and coalesce merge.
Anna: I'll try local repro with ASAN build and increase ordering logs in pt_coalesce. If we catch a free-before-complete we'll have a clear fix (add hook or fence).
Maya: tagging perf/regressions — @Anna @Rohit to own quick triage. I'll collect traces and upload to perf-bucket. :thumbsup:
Ethan: Next steps: Maya runs matrix and uploads traces; Anna runs ASAN + extra logs; Rohit scans commit for ordering gaps and protos a patch (add release fence + test). Aim for a hotfix if reproduced.
Anna: assigning myself and Rohit. Will update thread with repro log.
Rohit: if we need a mitigation ASAP, add a serializing counter bump on alloc path to avoid reuse until evict_complete confirmed. Ugly but fast.
Ethan: sounds good. Please ping me once you have a small reproducer or CI test I can run.
Maya: uploading traces now (perf-bucket/kv-pageindex-reuse/1739154321).
nv-pager-bot: uploaded trace bundle to perf-bucket/kv-pageindex-reuse/1739154321 (size=42MB)
Ethan: thanks — will review tonight and follow up in the morning.
